rows: Short remaining lease term is discounted by buyers because no verified quote set exists
Sale price, buyer pool, time on market
Collect arm's-length quotes before pricing; publish no inferred discount.
Capital gains, depreciation recapture, NIIT and California ordinary-income treatment reduce net proceeds
Use the after-tax module with private owner inputs; test a section 1031 alternative.
Change of ownership triggers reassessment for the buyer, affecting bid price
Verify the parcel's tax rate area and current bill privately.
A sale closes before a lease notice or option deadline is reconciled
Reconcile the private lease abstract to the notice calendar before any commitment.
System-level same-store sales and unit counts decline while local food-services employment rises
Percentage rent, tenant credit, renewal rent
Track multi-period SEC filings and local EDD series; require unit-level rent coverage.
Tenant exercises a closure program or does not renew
Rent interruption, re-tenanting cost, exit liquidity
Verify the lease guarantor and unit performance privately; model downtime.
Inflation raises operating and insurance costs while rent escalations are fixed
Compare EDD/CPI series with the private lease escalation schedule.
Regional population declines while SCAG projects long-run employment growth
Do not mix DOF observations with SCAG projections; fix tract trends.
Major earthquake damages the building or triggers a mapped-zone disclosure
Loss of rent, repairs, insurance deductible, exit liquidity
Run EQ ZApp and engineering review; hold earthquake coverage; stress all three channels jointly.
Wildfire destroys the local economy or materially changes FHSZ designations
Physical loss, prolonged closure, buyer pool, insurance market
Check FHSZ viewer and the locally adopted ordinance; note the open 2026 SRA comment period; price business interruption privately.
Flood damages the site or a map change requires insurance
Check the effective NFHL/FIRM and pending map changes; NFIP has a typical 30-day waiting period.
Insurance availability or cost shifts materially
Track CDI market snapshots and obtain actual quotes; joint stress with hazard events.
Owner privacy is breached by publishing an APN, lease or financial record
Personal safety, legal exposure, negotiating position
Keep all identifying records offline/access-controlled; this site publishes aggregate, non-identifying findings only.
A versioned cash-flow model is back-tested on insufficient comparable history
Publish observations and assumptions separately; gate the model on verified inputs and sufficient comps.
